column1: DENGUE CASE REPORTING During the 37th week, 1156 suspected dengue cases were reported across 25 districts, compared to 1152 cases in the    previous  week,  reflecting  0.35%  increase.  The  Western Province  accounted  for  43.1%  of  total  cases,  with  the Colombo  Municipal  Council  (CMC)  contributing  3.2%, the  rest  of  Colombo  District  14.7%,  Gampaha  District 18.9%,  and  Kalutara  District  6.3%.  Outside  the  Western Province,  notable  case  contributions  were  reported  from Kandy  (15.1%),  Kegalle  (6%),  Galle  (6%),  Ratnapura (3.8%),  Kurunegala (3.3%),  Matara (3.3%),  Puttalam (2.9%), Kalmunai (2.7%), and Badulla (2.2%) (see Table 1) (compared to the  previous  week, colour  of  %: red=increase, green=decrease, blue=no change). Previously  classified  10  high-risk MOH areas in week 36, were not identified as high-risk in the 37th week of 2026 (Table 2). MIDNIGHT TOTAL OF DENGUE PATIENT ADMISSIONS * After incorporating delayed hospital reports, the average midnight total for the 36th week increased from 449 to 450. In  the  37th  week  of  2026,  the  average  midnight  total  of dengue  patients  across  73  sentinel  hospitals  was  447. Compared to the  previous  week, in the  37th  week,  29 hospitals reported an increase, while 20 reported a decrease.
